title: Glowing roller skate
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Boot body - bright pink -->
  <path d='M25 45 Q25 30 35 28 L60 25 Q72 24 75 35 L78 55 Q78 65 68 68 L40 70 Q28 70 26 60 Z' fill='#ff4d94'/>
  <!-- Boot toe highlight - lighter pink -->
  <path d='M30 42 Q30 32 38 30 L55 28 Q62 27 63 35 L62 48 Q55 50 45 50 L32 50 Z' fill='#ff85b3'/>
  <!-- Ankle cuff - bright yellow -->
  <rect x='58' y='20' width='20' height='10' rx='4' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <!-- Lace area - bright cyan -->
  <path d='M40 35 L55 33 L56 38 L41 40 Z' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <path d='M39 42 L54 40 L55 45 L40 47 Z' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <path d='M38 49 L53 47 L54 52 L39 54 Z' fill='#00e5ff'/>
  <!-- Sole - bright orange -->
  <path d='M20 62 Q18 58 25 56 L78 52 Q84 52 84 58 L85 68 Q85 72 78 72 L25 72 Q18 72 20 62 Z' fill='#ff8c00'/>
  <!-- Sole edge highlight -->
  <path d='M22 60 L80 56 L81 59 L23 63 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- Wheels - glowing green with darker rims -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='78' r='9' fill='#00ff88'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='78' r='5' fill='#00cc66'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='78' r='2' fill='#ccffcc'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='78' r='9' fill='#00ff88'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='78' r='5' fill='#00cc66'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='78' r='2' fill='#ccffcc'/>
  <!-- Axle mounts - bright silver-blue -->
  <rect x='28' y='70' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#99ddff'/>
  <rect x='58' y='70' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#99ddff'/>
  <!-- Glow aura around skate - soft purple ellipse -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='52' rx='42' ry='38' fill='#cc66ff' opacity='0.15'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='52' rx='32' ry='30' fill='#cc66ff' opacity='0.1'/>
  <!-- Sparkles - tiny bright dots -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffff66'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='25' r='2.5' fill='#ffff66'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='70' r='2' fill='#ffff66'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='65' r='2.5' fill='#ffff66'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='88' r='1.5' fill='#ffff66'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='85' r='2' fill='#ffff66'/>
</svg>
